record.context_brief: homeomorphically irreducible spanning trees in planar graphs
record.original_question: Does every 4-connected planar graph have a homeomorphically irreducible spanning tree, meaning a spanning tree with no vertices of degree 2?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 4.8 Every 4-connected planar graph has a homeomorphically irreducible spanning tree.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A graph is called planar if it can be embedded in the plane without edge crossings, and is said to be 4-connected if it has at least 5 vertices and remains connected after the removal of any 3 vertices. A spanning tree T of a graph G is a connected acyclic subgraph of G containing every vertex of G. A spanning tree T is called homeomorphically irreducible (a HIST) if T has no vertex of degree exactly 2.

Question: Does every 4-connected planar graph admit a homeomorphically irreducible spanning tree?
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture that every 4-connected planar graph contains a homeomorphically irreducible spanning tree (HIST) remains open. Recent work (e.g., a 2024 paper on HIST-critical graphs and related Malkevitch-type conjectures) investigates the problem and makes partial progress, but does not provide a full resolution. Related results are known for triangulations of surfaces (Albertson–Berman–Hutchinson–Thomassen) and a related Lovász–Plummer conjecture about spanning Halin subgraphs in 4-connected plane triangulations has been disproved.

status_evidence.title: HIST-Critical Graphs and Malkevitch's Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates whether every 4-connected planar graph possesses a HIST; partial progress on HIST-critical graphs but no full resolution.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture remains open as of 2024.

status_evidence.title: Homeomorphically Irreducible Spanning Trees (HIST)
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys HIST results, including the Albertson–Berman–Hutchinson–Thomassen theorem for surface triangulations and the disproof of the Lovász–Plummer spanning Halin conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Related conjectures resolved, but the 4-connected planar HIST conjecture is not listed as solved.
